evidence: La2O3 and HfO2 gate dielectrics were formed using ALD in a cross-ﬂow reactor. HfO2 ﬁlms were deposited on 200 mm Si(100) substrates using HfCl4 and H2O.33 La2O3 ﬁlms were deposited using C18H54N3LaSi6 and H2O. Film deposition occurs through alternating pulses of metal containing precursor and water. A deposition cycle is deﬁned as a pulse of metal containing precursor, a nitrogen purge to remove un-reacted precursor, a water pulse, and a ﬁnal nitrogen purge.
